question: Semen analysis should be requested at the initial visit when investigating an infertile couple, as male factor accounts for approximately 30–40% of infertility cases.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. Male factor is implicated in approximately 30–40% of infertility cases; semen analysis is non-invasive and should be part of the initial simultaneous evaluation of both partners.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Semen analysis is non-invasive, inexpensive, and informative — and male factor contributes to infertility in approximately 30–40% of cases. Delaying it until after extensive female investigation is a common and avoidable error.
